description: Quick DEMO render on the public renderer (ephemeral, nothing stored). Limited to 2 runs per client, then deploy your own renderer and use make_surface_url. Onboarding only — not the workflow. DATA-IN-URL: keep payloads SMALL (URL < ~2000 chars); large payloads make long URLs that get truncated (→ render errors). For substantial content GRADUATE with emit_deployment instead — no size limit.

payload.description: The A2UI payload to preview: {title, theme, blocks:[...]}. Keep it small (URL under about 2000 chars).

name: preview_url

clipboard.description: Optional ready-made copy commands for the URL (linux, macos, windows) plus a note.

demo.description: Always true: this is a demo render.

limitReached.description: True when the per-client demo limit was hit; no link is returned then.

play_url.description: Link to the a2uicatalog.ai playground (recommended to share).

required_catalogs.description: Catalog URIs the payload needs (base catalog first).

size.description: Present when the URL is large: url_length, warning and recommendation.

url_length.description: Characters the URL is once the gas/ stable link is followed.

url.description: Link on the public Apps Script renderer.
